verdicts.note: Opened saved history through Messages and Show earlier messages. Approval event contains status timeout and interrupted true. Expiry notice remains; zero Allow/Deny, timer or running activity. Only two history page reads and no dispatch/resume.

Messages and Show earlier messages restore a gate with status timeout and interrupted true. No actionable approval buttons, active timers, running activity or running animations. Text stable after 1.5 seconds; only two history page reads and no dispatch/resume.
Storage reload, initial/hook restoration, server continuations, fresh Allow/Deny and custom renderer compatibility are covered by automated tests; this recording drives custom history pagination.
